Located in the heart of Toronto and Prince Edward County, Drake Hotel Properties are boutique hotels that blend culture, community, and hospitality for curious travellers who like to keep things interesting. The Drake is where creativity is sparked by connection — inviting you to explore, engage, and be inspired by the singular experiences that define each of our neighbourhood hotels.

From Toronto’s vibrant urban core to the scenic charm of Prince Edward County, The Drake’s properties are embedded in storied, character-rich neighbourhoods — offering a one-of-a-kind escape that feels both rooted and refreshing.

Toronto

Toronto

IN THE HEARTBEAT OF TORONTO — JUST STEPS FROM MAJOR ATTRACTIONS, VENUES, AND THE ENERGY OF THE DOWNTOWN CORE — THE DRAKE STANDS AS A BEACON OF CREATIVITY AND CULTURE. LOCATED ON DYNAMIC QUEEN STREET WEST, THE HOTEL BRINGS TOGETHER ART, MUSIC, AND CULINARY EXPERIENCES TO OFFER SOMETHING FOR EVERY KIND OF TRAVELLER, FROM BUSINESS GUESTS MIXING WORK WITH PLAY TO WEEKENDERS SOAKING UP THE CITY'S ELECTRIC ENERGY.

ELEVATED ESCAPES, WHEREVER YOU ROAM

From the coastal serenity of the Aegean to the golden dunes of the desert and the snow-capped peaks of the Dolomites, Casa Cook offers a collection of boutique, adults-only hotels designed for quiet luxury. Whether you seek sun-drenched beaches, mountain adventures, or tranquil desert landscapes, each destination invites you to slow down, reconnect, and savour the beauty of the moment.

HOTELS
Casa Cook Madonna
New Opening
CASA COOK MADONNA
Italy

Casa Cook is opening its first mountain retreat in the heart of Madonna di Campiglio, an iconic Italian mountain escape combining the best in alpine activities and local Italian tradition.

Casa Cook Samos
CASA COOK SAMOS
Greece

Nestled in the island’s lush, forested landscape, Casa Cook Samos gazes over the endless blues of the Aegean. Just a short drive from the airport and the historic village of Pythagorion

Casa Cook El Gouna
CASA COOK EL GOUNA
Egypt

Set between golden dunes and the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea, Casa Cook El Gouna is a secluded escape where modern design meets the raw beauty of Egypt’s coastline.

Casa Cook North Coast
CASA COOK NORTH COAST
Egypt

Tucked between sun-bleached dunes and the sparkling shores of the Mediterranean, Casa Cook North Coast is a secluded retreat on one of North Africa’s longest and most breathtaking coastlines.

Casa Cook Rhodes
CASA COOK RHODES
Greece

Tucked between the mountains and the sea in the laid-back village of Kolymbia, Casa Cook Rhodes is a modern retreat rooted in the rhythms of island life.

*THE* PLACE TO GO TO FOR A RELAXING COUPLES BREAK… HONESTLY IT’S THE BEST PLACE WE HAVE BEEN TO TO ESCAPE FROM THE WORLD AND TOTALLY RELAX. WE WENT HALF BOARD AND THE BREAKFAST AND DINNERS WERE ALL DELICIOUS. DRINKS ARE WELL PRICED AND DELICIOUS.
Casa Cook Rhodes – Charles, August 2024
Tripadvisor
TRULY AMAZING STAY THAT EXCEEDED OUR HIGH EXPECTATIONS. BEST STAFF EVER! SO FRIENDLY, FUNNY, PROFESSIONAL AND CARING. THE HOTEL ITSELF IS A PIECE OF ART IN DESIGN, CONCEPT AND LAYOUT. TO TOP IT ALL OFF THE BREAKFAST, LUNCH AND DINNER AT THE BEACHHOUSE EVERYDAY WAS SUCH A HIGH LEVEL!
Casa Cook Samos – Alexander, September 2023
Tripadvisor
BEST HOTEL IN EGYPT EVER!… OUR STAY WAS UNFORGETTABLE. THE CUISINE WAS EXTRAORDINARY AS WELL, BREAKFAST SUCH AS DINNER AND SNACKS. IN ADDITION THE STAFF WAS REALLY KIND AND ALWAYS HELPFUL. WE WANT TO COME BACK AS SOON AS POSSIBLE. 
Casa Cook El Gouna – Monika, August 2024

HIGHLIGHTS
Madonna through the eyes of our guests
MADONNA THROUGH THE EYES OF OUR GUESTS

Meet Jen from The September Chronicles, an Australian photographer and artist who captured what it’s like to experience Madonna di Campiglio in the summer.

Bedouin Nights at Casa Cook El Gouna
BEDOUIN NIGHTS AT CASA COOK EL GOUNA

Every Tuesday at sunset, experience an evening of Bedouin heritage with dance, grilled flavours, and soulful rhythms.

INTRODUCING CASA COOK MADONNA

Nestled in the picturesque village of Madonna di Campiglio, at the foot of Italy’s majestic Dolomites, Casa Cook Madonna is our first mountain retreat, and our newest hideaway. Opening in summer, this alpine escape fuses Casa Cook’s signature style with the untamed beauty of the peaks. Book directly on our website and enjoy 10% off your stay.

ELEVATED ESCAPES, WHEREVER YOU ROAM

From the coastal serenity of the Aegean to the golden dunes of the desert and the snow-capped peaks of the Dolomites, Casa Cook offers a collection of boutique, adults-only hotels designed for quiet luxury. Whether you seek sun-drenched beaches, mountain adventures, or tranquil desert landscapes, each destination invites you to slow down, reconnect, and savour the beauty of the moment.

HOTELS
Casa Cook Madonna
New Opening
CASA COOK MADONNA
Italy

Casa Cook is opening its first mountain retreat in the heart of Madonna di Campiglio, an iconic Italian mountain escape combining the best in alpine activities and local Italian tradition.

Casa Cook Samos
CASA COOK SAMOS
Greece

Nestled in the island’s lush, forested landscape, Casa Cook Samos gazes over the endless blues of the Aegean. Just a short drive from the airport and the historic village of Pythagorion

Casa Cook El Gouna
CASA COOK EL GOUNA
Egypt

Set between golden dunes and the crystal-clear waters of the Red Sea, Casa Cook El Gouna is a secluded escape where modern design meets the raw beauty of Egypt’s coastline.

Casa Cook North Coast
CASA COOK NORTH COAST
Egypt

Tucked between sun-bleached dunes and the sparkling shores of the Mediterranean, Casa Cook North Coast is a secluded retreat on one of North Africa’s longest and most breathtaking coastlines.

Casa Cook Rhodes
CASA COOK RHODES
Greece

Tucked between the mountains and the sea in the laid-back village of Kolymbia, Casa Cook Rhodes is a modern retreat rooted in the rhythms of island life.

*THE* PLACE TO GO TO FOR A RELAXING COUPLES BREAK… HONESTLY IT’S THE BEST PLACE WE HAVE BEEN TO TO ESCAPE FROM THE WORLD AND TOTALLY RELAX. WE WENT HALF BOARD AND THE BREAKFAST AND DINNERS WERE ALL DELICIOUS. DRINKS ARE WELL PRICED AND DELICIOUS.
Casa Cook Rhodes – Charles, August 2024
Tripadvisor
TRULY AMAZING STAY THAT EXCEEDED OUR HIGH EXPECTATIONS. BEST STAFF EVER! SO FRIENDLY, FUNNY, PROFESSIONAL AND CARING. THE HOTEL ITSELF IS A PIECE OF ART IN DESIGN, CONCEPT AND LAYOUT. TO TOP IT ALL OFF THE BREAKFAST, LUNCH AND DINNER AT THE BEACHHOUSE EVERYDAY WAS SUCH A HIGH LEVEL!
Casa Cook Samos – Alexander, September 2023

BEST HOTEL IN EGYPT EVER!… OUR STAY WAS UNFORGETTABLE. THE CUISINE WAS EXTRAORDINARY AS WELL, BREAKFAST SUCH AS DINNER AND SNACKS. IN ADDITION THE STAFF WAS REALLY KIND AND ALWAYS HELPFUL. WE WANT TO COME BACK AS SOON AS POSSIBLE.

INTRODUCING CASA COOK MADONNA

Nestled in the picturesque village of Madonna di Campiglio, at the foot of Italy’s majestic Dolomites, Casa Cook Madonna is our first mountain retreat, and our newest hideaway. Opening in summer, this alpine escape fuses Casa Cook’s signature style with the untamed beauty of the peaks. Book directly on our website and enjoy 10% off your stay.
